en: The postcard depicts a scenic overlook with a path and railing, leading to a viewpoint above a historically styled European town with orange-red rooftops. A lone figure stands at the railing. Dominating the town skyline is a large church or town building with a green onion-domed tower. Behind the town is a gently winding river flanked by more historic buildings. The scene is framed by foliage and large leafy tree branches, which arch over the top of the image.
